propositions: The idempotency integration test patches _now_iso only on binding_store_mod, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and related operations to binding_lifecycle.py, which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, causing the clock freeze to no longer reach those operations.

The test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but the oracle's blast radius narrowed and would not catch a regression if clear_absent unconditionally stamped updated_at.
The binding_lifecycle module maintains its own _now_iso reference at line 45, and clear_absent calls it at line 296 to stamp timestamps, bypassing the integration test's mock on binding_store.

Unit-tier coverage for the clear_absent no-stamp contract already exists in test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, but the integration-tier oracle should be restored to its original reach by patching both module clocks.
